text:
carla: Heads up, starting the v2 flip for /api/chat-stream in prod now. Doing a conservative slice ramp and extra mobile pin checks. docs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/rls/v2-chat-cutover 

deploy-bot: Canary job 3543219999 initiated. slices: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 25m. Auto-rollback thresholds configured.

tom: quick ask  which mobile user-agents are on hold by default? want to make sure old clients don't get malformed frames.

carla: holdlist: Android <= 1.4.2, iOS <= 2.0.0. SDK team pushed a schema bump note. if any UA in holdlist sees >0.2% streaming-frame-errors we auto-pin those tenants back to v1.

rachel: telemetry: streaming-frame-errors dashboard set to notify #eng-oncall at 0.2% over 10m and #mobile-team at 0.5%. also added a temporary log-hook to surface first-frame mismatches.

sam-server: checking canary metrics now. p50/p95 latency looks fine; p99 slightly up in us-west-1b. no 5xx spike.

ops-sre: handoff to ops for the next 40m. assigning eyes to @sam-server. will run a smoke test for ingress framing and backpressure.

sam-server: running smoke: open connections stable, backpressure counts normal. noticed a small uptick in client reconnects for an embedded tenant (t-819). digging.

rachel: pulling logs for t-819: see repeated `unsupported_frame_preface` errors from user-agent `mobile-1.4.0`. this is expected for holdlist; are they getting routed to v2 by mistake?

carla: double-checking pinlist: `deploybot pinlist --route /api/chat-stream` shows t-819 is NOT pinned. looks like traffic slicing landed them to v2. need immediate per-tenant shim.

deploy-bot: Command queued: `deploybot route-shim --tenant t-819 --to v1-shim --ttl 3600`

ops-sre: applied shim. confirmation: route override for t-819 -> v1-shim. TTL=3600s.

sam-server: after shim, reconnects drop to baseline. streaming-frame-errors for t-819 -> 0.00% in last 5m. good.

tom: note for postmortem: our slice assignment logic doesn't consider explicit mobile UA holdlist during ramp. We should add a preflight check that applies per-tenant shims if UA matches holdlist before allowing v2 traffic.

carla: agreed. immediate mitigation: updating ramp policy to exclude any tenant with known holdlist UA in the first two slices. I pushed patch: `opsctrl update-ramp-policy --exclude-holdlist-ua true`

deploy-bot: Ramp policy update accepted. New ramp rules will apply to next canary runs.

rachel: decision: keep t-819 shim for 1h and monitor other tenants for similar UA signatures. If streaming-frame-errors > 0.5% aggregated for mobile group for 15m, we'll pause the rollout and open rollback.

ops-sre: adding operator checklist used: 
```
# inspect pinlist
deploybot pinlist --route /api/chat-stream
# apply shim
deploybot route-shim --tenant t-819 --to v1-shim --ttl 3600
# list shims
deploybot route-shim --list --route /api/chat-stream
```

sam-server: also noted a minor spike in model-fallbacks around the same time, correlating to slice 2. fallback rate peaked at 0.9% then settled. keeping an eye.

carla: fallback under 1% is acceptable for now. rollback criteria spelled out: sustained 5xx > 1% for 20m OR streaming-frame-errors > 1% for 15m OR model-fallback > 5% for 30m. If triggered, automatic rollback will run but will require manual verification from @carla or @tom before full-scale route reversal.

tom: adding that we should notify partner customers with known large mobile fleets. @rachel please draft a short comms blurb pointing them to release notes and holdlist.

rachel: drafted and posted to #customer-comm: "We rolled out v2 for chat streaming. If you experience malformed frames, please upgrade SDK or contact support. We have temporary shims for affected tenants."

deploy-bot: Canary job 3543219999 progressed to 50% slices. No auto-rollback triggered.

ops-sre: continued monitoring. setting a rolling check every 5m for next 40m. I'll escalate if anomalies persist.

sam-server: ran a deeper trace for model-fallbacks  looks like a cold KV cache pattern for a small minority of tenants in slice 2. Cache-hit improvement after warmup.

carla: plan: keep rollout going but with tightened UA preflight and per-tenant shims if needed. post-cutover action items: 1) add UA holdlist enforcement to ramp controller 2) add pinlist audit to deploybot 3) retro notes in release docs.

rachel: tagging SDK leads @alex-mobile and @sam-server to validate that released patches will be available to clients in 24h.

alex-mobile: acknowledging. mobile patch ETA = 6h for full rollout; we'll cut an interim micro-release for critical customers.

ops-sre: closing handoff for this window, owners: @carla for rollout decisions, @sam-server for ops eyes. Will remove t-819 shim after TTL unless flagged. I'll post final closure msg at 3543220360.

carla: thanks everyone. final note: capture the used commands in cutover runbook and tag the canary job id 3543219999 in release notes. closing unless alerts trigger. :white_check_mark:
